# Local validation and deployment — @REPOSITORY@

This private repository uses **local validation**. Unavailable GitHub-hosted
workflows and automatic approval/merge callers have been removed from active
workflow discovery. Their definitions are preserved as text in
`docs/github-hosted-workflows/` for reference.

There is no required GitHub-hosted CI gate, scheduled hosted nightly, Code Scanning
upload or protected-environment approval. No paid feature or higher spending limit
is required. `NIGHTLY_CHECKS_ENABLED` is not used by this policy.

## Local checks

Install the toolchains documented in `scripts/ci.sh` and the security adapter, then:

```bash
python3 scripts/release.py check
python3 scripts/release.py status
```

`check` runs every command in `.release-policy.json` in order and stops on failure.
Security findings, unavailable tools and incomplete scans are failures. `status`
and `doctor` only describe local configuration; they do not report a successful
check or contact GitHub. This repository does not publish application beta/RC/stable
releases through this client.

The declared local commands are:

@LOCAL_COMMANDS@

For local nightlies, use the toolkit's
[local runner and scheduler instructions](https://github.com/victron-venus/venus-os-ci-toolkit/blob/main/docs/LOCAL_NIGHTLY.md).
The runner records the checked SHA and durable logs. It does not fetch/update code,
install a scheduler or create release evidence. Maintainers keep the dedicated
checkouts current and inspect failed runs.

## Review and deployment

Before merging, the maintainer runs the local checks on the proposed revision and
records the SHA, commands, results and limitations in the PR. The absence of GitHub
checks is not a passing validation result. Independent review is an operating
practice, not a paid feature that this configuration claims to enforce.

Deployment is an explicit operator action after validation. Where this repository
already has a working self-hosted manual deployment workflow, that workflow remains
manual and runs its checks on the existing runner. Other repositories use their
documented local deployment procedure. This migration does not install a runner,
apply infrastructure or start a production deployment.

Terraform syntax/validation uses backend-disabled copies; it is not a reviewed
production plan. Inspect the exact saved plan and target configuration before an
explicit apply. Preserve existing production secrets and permissions.
